title: The Ledger Closes
subtitle: one_completed, and a split line
description: `prerequisiteMode: one_completed` opens this quest when any one of its dependencies is complete — the mode that lets a dependent survive an exclusive pair, since only one patron can ever be taken.

Its line to the gold patron is a split: `fromHandle` and `toHandle` are written together, each a `[along, across]` control point as a fraction of the line's own chord. One alone would be a split with half a shape.
